## Summary

The IEEE registry lists 12 MA-L blocks to "Cambridge Industries(Group) Co.,Ltd." at addresses in Shanghai (Qilai Tower, 889 Yishan Road, and 2388 ChenHang Road, Minhang District) and one block to "Cambridge Industries Group (CIG)" at 2560 Junction Avenue, San Jose [1]. The single product tie the session could document is the Adtran Total Access 324RG residential gateway, whose FCC test-unit board carries MAC labels from the D0:54:2D block, a block registered to this company [2][1]; the gateway is an Adtran product under FCC ID HDC1287562G1 and DeviWiki does not name its maker, so reading the company as the board's maker, and this as an ODM entry, is an inference [2].

That gateway has a Realtek RTL8192CE 2x2 802.11b/g/n radio, four gigabit LAN ports with a Realtek RTL8214B, and a Lantiq DUSLIC-xT2 PEF 3201 F [2]. A MAC in these blocks is therefore most likely a carrier-branded broadband gateway built by this company, but that is inferred from one product, not stated by a source [2].

Founding year, parent, the company's own product list and FCC grantee codes are unknown: the company's site did not resolve, Wikipedia has no article under the names tried, and the FCC ID databases refused the session's requests. NVD returned no records under the company's name, so no security notes are listed. Randomization is unknown.
